title: run --cloud and the overview ignore the factory run's project; a frozen 'running' record is attached forever
body: cloudRunsForEpic (run_cloud.go:171-178) matches on epic only, so 'ticfac run abc --cloud' in repo A attaches to repo B's run for epic abc; the overview lists every project's runs and reads this repo's records/PR for them. run --cloud decides attach vs resume from the record state alone and never consults cloudRunLiveness, so a dead instance behind a 'running' record is attached to forever. status/watch by epic id never look in the factory.
